text:
sarah.k: EOD async check-in — audits / IAM / KMS.
- Done: completed key-rotation dry-run in staging (no data loss), closed 3 low-priority Snyk alerts by bumping deps, scanned for orphaned service accounts.
- Blockers: rotation cron change needs infra approval (PR open), staging image build failing due to `libssl` mismatch.
- Today/Tomorrow: will pair with @alex on the image fix, schedule canary rotation at 19:00 UTC if PR merges.

raj.patel: nice. left a tiny comment on the PR about the rollback window. otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

maria: re: orphaned service accounts — I exported the list to `s3://sec-temp/orphan-accounts.csv` and added owners where I could. can we run a 7-day notify before auto-deleting?

sarah.k: yep, plan is notify -> 7d grace -> disable -> 30d delete. i'll add the notify job to the rotation PR.

alex: I can jump on the image build in ~30m. quick heads-up: the failing step is `apt-get` complaining about `libssl1.1` not present in base. probable easy fix is switch to the newer base or pin openssl.

noah: FYI I kicked off a targeted eval on the canary model route to make sure tokenization doesn't regress after the rotation. results should land in console under `engsec/canary-rotations` by EOD. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy request received — infra/pr-472 — running CI checks. status: queued -> running.

maria: also pinged legal about the compliance note for cross-region key replicas. they want the architecture diagram and acceptance criteria for the replica read-only policy.

dave: quick blocker from my side: need a service-account-level KMS grant for the backup job in us-west-2. opened ticket INFRA-1298, tagging @infra oncall.

raj.patel: INFRA-1298 noted. infra oncall — can you expedite the grant? backup window tomorrow morning.

sarah.k: thanks all. action items: (1) @alex fix image and merge PR, (2) @maria follow up with legal + diagram, (3) infra to action INFRA-1298, (4) i will kick the canary rotation after CI passes. ping if you need pairing. :shipit:
